================================================================================
K-SOFTID: open/override used as identifiers
================================================================================

// `open` and `override` are modifier keywords but valid identifiers:
// `private var open = true` (installerx), `open(filename)` (trime),
// `forEach { override -> }` (zhihu-plus-plus).

fun a() { val open = 1; open(2) }

class A : SeekableByteChannel {
    private var open = true
    override fun close() { open = false }
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (line_comment)
  (line_comment)
  (line_comment)
  (function_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    (function_value_parameters)
    (function_body
      (block
        (property_declaration
          (variable_declaration
            (identifier))
          (number_literal))
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (value_arguments
            (value_argument
              (number_literal)))))))
  (class_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    (delegation_specifiers
      (delegation_specifier
        (user_type
          (identifier))))
    (class_body
      (property_declaration
        (modifiers
          (visibility_modifier))
        (variable_declaration
          (identifier))
        (identifier))
      (function_declaration
        (modifiers
          (member_modifier))
        name: (identifier)
        (function_value_parameters)
        (function_body
          (block
            (assignment
              left: (identifier)
              right: (identifier))))))))

================================================================================
K-PARENANNO: annotation on a parenthesized function type
================================================================================

// `content: @Composable (() -> Unit)` — installerx/seal composable
// slots. The paren type carries its own annotations-only modifiers;
// `suspend` always binds the enclosing function type instead.

fun f(content: @Composable (() -> Unit)) {}
fun g(f: suspend (Int).() -> Unit) {}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

          (paren_type_modifiers
            (annotation
              (user_type
                (identifier))))
          (function_type
            (function_type_parameters)
            (user_type
              (identifier))))))
    (function_body
      (block)))
  (function_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    (function_value_parameters
      (parameter
        (identifier)
        (function_type
          (type_modifiers)
          (parenthesized_type
            (user_type
              (identifier)))
          (function_type_parameters)
          (user_type
            (identifier)))))
    (function_body
      (block))))

================================================================================
K-ARRLIT: empty array literal in an annotation argument
================================================================================

// `indices = []` — Room @Entity (installerx). `[]` is only legal in
// annotation arguments but the grammar's collection_literal required
// at least one element.

@Entity(tableName = "config", indices = [])
data class ConfigEntity(val id: Int)

================================================================================
K-NEWLINECTOR: primary constructor parameter list on the next line
================================================================================

// `internal class C\n/** doc */\n    (x: Int)` — mlkit, dbflow,
// facebook-android-sdk. The scanner used to emit _semi after the
// class name, ending the declaration before `(`.

internal class D
/** doc */
    (x: Int) {
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

================================================================================
K-SUPERNL: superclass call arguments on the next line
================================================================================

// `class D : Base\n() {}` — the scanner cannot suppress the semi before a
// delegation's `(` (its valid-symbol mask matches a `(` after a complete
// statement), so the constructor invocation tolerates the separator.

class D : Base
() {
}

class E : Iface1, Base
(arg) {
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

================================================================================
K-SUSPENDWRAP: suspend on a fully wrapped function type
================================================================================

// `suspend ((A) -> B)` — ktor's JWT verifier returns this shape. `suspend`
// joins the paren-type modifiers; `suspend (Int).() -> Unit` still binds it
// to the enclosing function type.

val v: suspend ((A) -> B)

            (identifier)))))))

================================================================================
K-IFLOOP: loop statements as if/else branch bodies
================================================================================

// `if (m) for (c in ys) D()` and `else while (d) x--` — branches take
// control-structure bodies, not only expressions. Upstream v1.1.0 lexes
// `for` as an identifier here and mis-shapes the call.

fun f() {
  if (m) for (c in ys) D() else while (d) g()
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (line_comment)
  (line_comment)
  (line_comment)
  (function_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    (function_value_parameters)
    (function_body
      (block
        (if_expression
          condition: (identifier)
          (for_statement
            (variable_declaration
              (identifier))
            (identifier)
            (call_expression
              (identifier)
              (value_arguments)))
          (while_statement
            condition: (identifier)
            (call_expression
              (identifier)
              (value_arguments))))))))

================================================================================
K-IFLOOP2: destructured for variables inside an if branch
================================================================================

// `if (a) for ((p, q) in m) { g() } else h()` — a multi-variable for
// header inside an unbraced if branch (TaskPage.kt / Session.kt shapes).

fun f() {
  if (a) for ((p, q) in m) { g() } else { h() }
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

          condition: (identifier)

            (multi_variable_declaration
              (variable_declaration
                (identifier))
              (variable_declaration
                (identifier)))
            (identifier)
            (block
              (call_expression
                (identifier)
                (value_arguments))))
          (block
            (call_expression
              (identifier)
              (value_arguments))))))))
